EPICON_amp1_meg_cla_l <- 
  EPICON_amp1_meg_cla %>% pivot_longer(
    names_to = "Sample_ID", values_to = "Reads_num_amp", -Class
  )


# meg
# EPICON_meg_cla
EPICON_meg_cla_l <- 
  EPICON_meg_cla %>% pivot_longer(
    names_to = "Sample_ID", values_to = "Reads_num_meg", -Class
  ) %>% 
  group_by(Sample_ID) %>% mutate(
    R_p_meg = Reads_num_meg / sum(Reads_num_meg)
  ) %>% mutate(
    MERGE_index = str_c(Class, Sample_ID, sep = "_")
  ) %>% ungroup()

# amp adj
EPICON_amp1_meg_cla_l_adj <- 
  EPICON_amp1_meg_cla_l %>% left_join(
    EPICON_amp_meg_RRN_tab %>% select(Class, rDNA_m, GS_m), by = "Class") %>% 
  mutate(
    rDNA_m = if_else(is.na(rDNA_m), EPICON_amp_meg_RRN_mean, rDNA_m),
    GS_m = if_else(is.na(GS_m), EPICON_amp_meg_GS_mean, GS_m)
  ) %>% mutate(
    Reads_num_amp_adj_RRN = Reads_num_amp / rDNA_m,
    Reads_num_amp_adj_GS = Reads_num_amp * GS_m,
    Reads_num_amp_adj_RRNGS = Reads_num_amp / rDNA_m * GS_m
  ) %>% group_by(
    Sample_ID
  ) %>% mutate(
    R_p = Reads_num_amp / sum(Reads_num_amp),
    R_p_adj_RRN = Reads_num_amp_adj_RRN / sum(Reads_num_amp_adj_RRN),
    R_p_adj_GS = Reads_num_amp_adj_GS / sum(Reads_num_amp_adj_GS),
    R_p_adj_RRNGS = Reads_num_amp_adj_RRNGS / sum(Reads_num_amp_adj_RRNGS)
  ) %>% mutate(
    MERGE_index = str_c(Class, Sample_ID, sep = "_")
  )

amp1_meg_Class_top <- c(amp1_meg_unadj_top_Class,
                        amp1_meg_adj_top_Class,
                        meg_top_Class) %>% unique()


EPICON_comp_amp_meg_part1 <- 
  EPICON_amp1_meg_cla_l_adj %>% 
  select(Class, Sample_ID, Reads_num_amp, Reads_num_amp_adj_GS, Reads_num_amp_adj_RRN, Reads_num_amp_adj_RRNGS) %>% 
  mutate(
    Class1 = if_else(Class %in% amp1_meg_Class_top, Class, "Others")
  ) %>% left_join(
    EPICON_metadata_amp_meg %>% select(Sample_ID_1, COMPARTMENT, TIME, Treatment),
    by = c("Sample_ID" = "Sample_ID_1")) %>% 
  group_by(Sample_ID) %>% 
  mutate(
    per_amp = Reads_num_amp / sum(Reads_num_amp),
    per_amp_adj_GS = Reads_num_amp_adj_GS / sum(Reads_num_amp_adj_GS),
    per_amp_adj_RRN = Reads_num_amp_adj_RRN / sum(Reads_num_amp_adj_RRN),
    per_amp_adj_RRNGS = Reads_num_amp_adj_RRNGS / sum(Reads_num_amp_adj_RRNGS)
  ) %>% ungroup() %>% 
  group_by(COMPARTMENT, TIME, Treatment, Class1) %>% 
  summarise(
    p_amp_unadj_m = mean(per_amp),
    p_amp_adj_GS_m = mean(per_amp_adj_GS),
    p_amp_adj_RRN_m = mean(per_amp_adj_RRN),
    p_amp_adj_RRNGS_m = mean(per_amp_adj_RRNGS)
  ) %>% ungroup() %>% 
  pivot_longer(
    names_to = "Methods", values_to = "abd", 5:8
  )
## `summarise()` has regrouped the output.
## ℹ Summaries were computed grouped by COMPARTMENT, TIME, Treatment, and Class1.

EPICON_comp_amp_meg_part2 <- 
  EPICON_meg_cla_l %>% select(Class, Sample_ID, Reads_num_meg) %>% 
  mutate(
    Class1 = if_else(Class %in% amp1_meg_Class_top, Class, "Others")
  ) %>% left_join(
    EPICON_metadata_amp_meg %>% select(Sample_ID_1, COMPARTMENT, TIME, Treatment),
    by = c("Sample_ID" = "Sample_ID_1")) %>% 
  group_by(Sample_ID) %>% 
  mutate(
    per_meg = Reads_num_meg / sum(Reads_num_meg)
  ) %>% ungroup() %>% 
  group_by(COMPARTMENT, TIME, Treatment, Class1) %>% 
  summarise(
    per_meg_m = mean(per_meg)
  ) %>% 
  pivot_longer(
    names_to = "Methods", values_to = "abd", 5
  )

# RRNGS
EPICON_amp_meg_bias_Glo_RRNGS <- 
  EPICON_amp_meg_bias_RRNGS %>% filter(Class == "Glomeromycetes") %>% 
  select(Sample_ID, amp_non_adj_bias, amp_adj_bias) %>% 
  left_join(
    EPICON_metadata_amp_meg %>% select(Sample_ID_1, COMPARTMENT, TIME, Treatment), 
    by = c("Sample_ID" = "Sample_ID_1") 
  ) %>% 
  pivot_longer(
    names_to = "Methods", values_to = "bias", 2:3
  )


EPICON_amp_meg_bias_Glo_RRNGS1 <- 
  EPICON_amp_meg_bias_Glo_RRNGS %>% 
  mutate(
    TIME = str_replace(TIME, pattern = "TP0", "")
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    TIME = str_replace(TIME, pattern = "TP", "")
  )


EPICON_amp_meg_bias_Glo_RRNGS1$TIME <- 
  factor(EPICON_amp_meg_bias_Glo_RRNGS1$TIME, levels = c(3, 4, 8, 9, 10, 11))




EPICON_amp_meg_bias_Glo_RRNGS1$Methods <- factor(EPICON_amp_meg_bias_Glo_RRNGS1$Methods, 
                                           levels = c("amp_non_adj_bias", "amp_adj_bias"))

EPICON_bias_AMF_meg_RRNGS <- EPICON_amp_meg_bias_Glo_RRNGS1

EPICON_bias_AMF_meg_RRNGS$TIME <- EPICON_bias_AMF_meg_RRNGS$TIME %>% as.vector() %>% as.numeric()

# EPICON_bias_AMF_meg_RRNGS$TIME %>% table()

EPICON_bias_AMF_meg_RRNGS_t.test <- 
  EPICON_bias_AMF_meg_RRNGS %>% select(Sample_ID, Methods, bias) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Methods, values_from = bias)


bias_AMF_meg_RRNGS_t.test <- 
  t.test(EPICON_bias_AMF_meg_RRNGS_t.test$amp_non_adj_bias,
         EPICON_bias_AMF_meg_RRNGS_t.test$amp_adj_bias, paired = T)

# bias_AMF_meg_RRNGS_t.test$p.value

# help("geom_half_violin")

EPICON_bias_AMF_meg_RRNGS %>% group_by(Methods) %>% 
  summarise(
    bias_m = mean(bias)
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    fold_m = exp(bias_m)
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    fold_m1 = 1/fold_m
  )
## # A tibble: 2 × 4
##   Methods          bias_m fold_m fold_m1
##   <fct>             <dbl>  <dbl>   <dbl>
## 1 amp_non_adj_bias -2.80  0.0608  16.5  
## 2 amp_adj_bias      0.557 1.75     0.573
# plot
fig_4i_new_amf_dev <- 
  ggplot(EPICON_bias_AMF_meg_RRNGS) +
  geom_half_violin(aes(Methods, bias), side = c("l", "r"), colour = NA, fill = "grey85") +
  geom_path(aes(Methods, bias, group = Sample_ID), colour = "grey95") +
  geom_point(aes(Methods, bias, colour = Methods), size = 2.8, alpha = 0.4, show.legend = F) +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = c("amp_non_adj_bias", "amp_adj_bias"),
                   labels = c("uncorrected", "corrected")) +
  # scale_colour_gradient2(breaks = seq(3, 11, 2),
  #                        labels = seq(3, 11, 2),
  #                        # low = "#4455CC", high = "#FF007F",
  #                        low = "blue", high = "red",
  #                        mid = "grey90", midpoint = 7) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("#4455CC", "#FF007F")) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 2, colour = "black") +
  annotate(geom = "text", x = 1.5, y = 3, 
           label = expression("t" == "-255.02;" ~~ "df" == "51"), size = 3.8) +
  annotate(geom = "text", x = 1.5, y = 2.5, 
           label = expression(italic(p) == "6.999e-81"), size = 3.8) +
  #scale_alpha(breaks = seq(2, 17, 1),
  #            labels = seq(2, 17, 1),
  #            range = c(0.05, 0.7)) +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(title = "Week")) +
  labs(y = "Devation of Glomeromycetes") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(), 
        strip.text = element_text(size = 15,face = "bold"), 
        panel.spacing = unit(0, "lines"),
        legend.title = element_text(colour = "black", size = 15, face = "bold"),
        legend.text = element_text(colour = "black", size = 12, face = "bold"),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", colour = "black"),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold", colour = "black"),
        title = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
        legend.position = "right")

# PCoA
parse_PcoA <- function(DF, METADATA, PRE_METHOD) {
  
  # calcu euclidean dist
  DF_rel <- decostand(DF, method = PRE_METHOD)
  
  DF_dist <- vegdist(DF_rel, method = "bray")
  
  # PCoA analysis
  TMP_pcoa_result <- wcmdscale(DF_dist, k = 2, eig = TRUE)
  
  # tmp
  # return(TMP_pcoa_result)
  
  TMP_points <- as.data.frame(TMP_pcoa_result$points)
  
  colnames(TMP_points) <- c("PCoA1", "PCoA2")
  
  TMP_points1 <- TMP_points %>% mutate(
    Sample_ID = rownames(.)
  ) %>% left_join(
    METADATA, by = "Sample_ID")
  
  # eig
  all_eig <- TMP_pcoa_result$eig
  pos_eig <- all_eig[all_eig > 0]
  
  TMP_var_explained <- round(pos_eig / sum(pos_eig) * 100, 2)[1:2]
  
  
  # rlts
  pcoa_rlts <- list(
    main_df = TMP_points1,
    dist = DF_dist,
    axis_eig = TMP_var_explained
  )
  
  return(pcoa_rlts)
  
}

    aes(PCoA1, PCoA2, group = sample_id),
    colour = "grey90"
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = EPICON_UCT_meg_GS_pcoa$main_df, 
    aes(PCoA1, PCoA2, colour = Methods),
    size = 3.2, alpha = 0.7) +
  annotate(geom = "text", x = -0.15, y = 0.30, 
           label = expression("uncorrected vs metagenome:" ~~ italic(R^2) == 0.459 ~~ italic(p) == 0.001),
           size = 3.8, parse = T, hjust = 0) +
  annotate(geom = "text", x = -0.15, y = 0.25, 
           label = expression("gs corrected vs metagenome:" ~~ italic(R^2) == 0.363 ~~ italic(p) == 0.001),

    labels = c("uncorrected", "gs corrected", "metagenome"),
    values = c("#4455CC", "#FF007F", "#F5B700")
  ) +
  guides(alpha = guide_legend(title = "Week", ncol = 1),
         colour = guide_legend(title = "Method", ncol = 1)) +
  labs(x = str_c("PCoA1 (", EPICON_UCT_meg_GS_pcoa$axis_eig[1], "%)"),
       y = str_c("PCoA2 (", EPICON_UCT_meg_GS_pcoa$axis_eig[2], "%)")) +
  # scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-0.2, 0.3)) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.text = element_text(face = "bold",
                             size = 12,
                             colour = "black",
                             hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5),
    axis.title.x = element_text(face = "bold",
                                size = 13),
    axis.title.y = element_text(face = "bold",
                                size = 13),
    axis.text.x = element_text(vjust = 0.5, hjust = 0.5),
    plot.title = element_text(
      colour = "darkgreen", size = 18, face = "bold.italic", hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5
    ),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12, colour = "black", face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10, colour = "black", face = "bold"),
    legend.box = "horizontal",
    legend.position = "inside",
    legend.position.inside = c(0.85, 0.2),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = alpha("white", 0.7), colour = NA),
    legend.spacing.y = unit(0, "cm"),
    legend.margin = margin(2, 2, 2, 2, unit = "pt")
  )
